notes.title: Improvements
notes.content:
Minor visual update!
[list]
[*] The minigame (there's only one) used to be very easy to miss.  Now it's about impossible to miss.  Be sure to return after major plot events for even more unlockables!
[/list]
Bug fixes!
[list]
[*] Wrong music would play in certain zones under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed possible issue with game crashing when interacting under certain circumstances
[*] The final boss could skip certain animations
[/list]
Performance boost!
[list]
[*] Lots of small coding updates
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.3.7 live! (bug fixes)
notes.content:
​Just 3 fixes:
[list]
[*] One of Cane's abilities said it inflicted Dark, when it actually inflicted Stun
[*] In the final battle, adjusted cost of a tech
[*]Soft lock fix!  Maybe not *the* soft lock fix, but if you went to interact with something while the screen was still fading in, it would cause a soft lock
[/list]

notes.title: bug fixes
notes.content:
List of changes
[list]
[*]Rarely, some players would experience the game soft locking when shopping
[*]When Zemi tells Pech she'll introduce to him to everyone in the village, this includes the 2 villagers outside the village (which is now clear)
[*]You could walk through the top of Pametrice's house to enter the door
[*]Repeatedly opening/closing the load menu from the title screen made the menu drift
[*]If a certain character hit level 20, looking at their skills caused the game to crash
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed 2 bugs
[list]
[*]When you step on a room transition square, you could step/turn away, and the screen would get dark but there would be no transition
[*]If you paused/unpaused, multiple songs could play
[/list]
